spans.s:
1 A worm.
--2 An insect.
see कृमि.
--Comp.
--जं aloewood.
--शैलः an ant-hill.

क्रियः The sign of the Zodiac
called Aries.

क्रिया [कृ भावे करणादौ वा श]
1
Doing, execution, performance,
accomplishment; उपचार˚, धर्म˚; प्रत्युक्तं हि
प्रणयिषु सताभीप्सितार्थक्रियैव

.
--2 An action, act, business,
undertaking; प्रणयिक्रिया

.
--3 Activity, bodily action,
labour.
--4 Teaching, instruction;
क्रिया हि वस्तूपहिता प्रसीदति

.
--5 Possession of some art (as of
singing, dancing &c.), knowledge;
शिष्टा क्रिया कस्याचिदात्मसंस्था

.
--6 Practice (opp. शास्त्र theory).
--7 A literary work, composition;
शृणुत मनोभिरवाहितैः क्रियामिमां
कालिदासस्य

.
--8 A
purificatory rite, a religious rite or
ceremony.
--9 An expiatory rite,
expiation.
--10 (a) The ceremony of
offering oblations to the deceased
ancestors (श्राद्ध). (b) Obsequies.
--11
Worship.
--12 Medical treatment,
application of remedies, cure;
शीतक्रिया

cold remedies.
--13
(In gram.) Action, the general idea
expressed by a verb.
--14 Motion
[]
--15 Especially, motion as one of the
seven categories of the Vaiśeṣikas;
see कर्मन्.
--16 (In law) Judicial
investigation by human means
(witnesses &c.) or by ordeals.
--17 Burden of proof; क्रिया
स्याद्वादिनोर्द्वयोः; द्वयोरपि वादिनोः क्रिया प्राप्नोति
V. May.
--18 A verb.
--19 A noun of
action.
--20 Disquisition.
--21 Study.
--22 Means, expedients,
--23
Instrument, implement.
--Comp.
--अन्वित a.
practising ritual observances.
--अपवर्गः {1} completion or termination of
an affair, execution of a task,
क्रियापवर्गेष्वनुजीविसात् कृताः

.
{2} liberation from ceremonial acts,
absolution.
--अभ्युपगमः a special
agreement; क्रियाभ्युपगमात्त्वेतत् बीजार्थं
यत्प्रदीयते

.
--अवसन्न a. one
who loses a law-suit through the
statements of the witnesses &c.
--इंद्रियं see कर्मेंद्रिय.
--कलापः the
whole body of ceremonies enjoined in
the Hindu religious law. {2} all the
particulars or points of any business.
--कारः {1} an agent, worker. {2} a
beginner, tyro, a fresh student. {3} an
agreement.
--द्वेषिन् m. a witness whose
testimony is prejudicial to the cause
(one of the five kinds of witnesses).
--द्वैतं efficient cause.
--निर्देशः
evidence.
--पटुं a. dexterous.
--पथः
mode of medical treatment.
--पदं a
verb.
--पर a. diligent in the
performance of one's duty.
--पादः the
third division of a legal plaint; that
is, witnesses, documents and other
proofs adduced by the plaintiff or
complainant.
--योगः {1} connection
with the verb. {2} the employment
of expedients or means. {3} active
devotion.
--लोपः omission or
discontinuance of any of the essential
ceremonies of the Hindu religion;
क्रियालोपात् वृषलत्वं गताः

.
--वशः necessary influence of acts
done.
--वाचक, --वाचिन् a.
expressing any action, as a verbal noun.
--वादिन् m. a plaintiff, complainant.
--विधिः a rule of action, manner of
any rite;

.
--विशेषणं {1}
an adverb. {2} a predicative
adjective.
--शक्तिः f. the power of god
(in creating this world)
--संक्रातिः
f. imparting (to others) one's
knowledge; teaching;

.
[]
--समभिहारः the repetition of any act
Śi. 2. 43.

क्रियावत् a.
1 Engaged in any
actual work, versed in the practice
of a thing; यस्तु क्रियान्पुरुषः स विद्वान्

.
--2 Performing ceremonies
in the right manner.

Doing,
performing.
--2 Killing.
--विः
1 A cistern,
well.
--2 A leather bag; a cloud (?)
--3 N. of the country of पांचाल.

क्री {c9c} U. (क्रीणाति, क्रीणीते, क्रीत)
1
To buy, purchase; महता पुण्यपण्येन
क्रीतेयं कायनौस्त्वया Śānti. 3. 1;
क्रीणीष्व मज्जीवितमेव पण्यमन्यन्न चेदस्ति
तदस्तु पुण्यं

.
--2 To barter,
exchange; कच्चित्सहस्रैर्मूर्खाणामेकं
क्रीणासि पंडितं Mb.
--3 To win. [cf. Pers.
kharidan].

क्री a. (At the end of comp.)
Buying.

क्रीत p. p. Bought; see क्री.
--तः One
of the twelve kinds of sons
recognised in Hindu Law; a son purchased
from his natural parents; क्रीतश्च
ताभ्यां विक्रीतः

.
--Comp.
--अनुशयः ‘repenting a purchase’,
rescission, returning a thing purchased to
the seller (admissible in some cases
by law).

क्रीतक a. Got by purchase.
--कः
A son bought from his parents and
adopted;

क्रीड् {c1c} P. (क्रीडति, क्रीडित)
1 To
play, amuse oneself; वानराः
क्रीडितुमारब्धाः

.
--2 To gamble, play at dice; बहुविधं
द्यूतं क्रीडतः

.
--3 To
jest, joke or trifle with;
सद्वृत्तस्तनमंडलस्तव कथं प्राणैर्मम क्रीडति

. --WITH
अनु (Atm.) to play, sport, amuse
oneself; साध्वनुक्रीडमानानि पश्य
वृंदानि पक्षिणां

; but
क्रीड् with सं is Paras. in the sense
of ‘making a noise’; त्वन्नामवर्णा
इव कर्णपीता मयास्य संक्रीडति चक्रचक्रे

क्रीड a [क्रीड्-घञ्] Playing,
sporting.
--डः
1 Sport, pastime, play,
pleasure.
--2 Jest, joke.

क्रीडा [क्रीड्-भावे अ]
1 Sport,
pastime, play, pleasure,
तोयक्रीडानिरतयुवतिस्नानतिक्तैर्मरुद्भिः

.
--2
Jest, joke.
--Comp.
--आकूतं a sportive
purpose.
--उद्देशः play ground.
--काननं, --वनं a pleasure grove, park.
--कोप
false or feigned anger;

.
--कौतूकं {1} wanton curiosity. {2}
sport, play. {3} sexual intercourse.
--गृहं, --मंदिरं a pleasure-house.
--नारी
a prostitute, harlot.
--मयूरः a
peacock kept for pleasure;

.
--मृगः a toy-deer.
--रत्नं ‘the gem of
sports’, copulation.
--वेश्मन् n. a
pleasure-house.
--शैलः, --पर्वतः an artificial
hill serving as a pleasure abode, a
pleasure mountain; क्रीडाशैलः
कनककदलीवेष्टनप्रेक्षणीयः

क्रीडनं [क्रीड् भावे ल्युट्]
1 Playing,
sporting
--2 A play-thing, toy.

क्रीडनकः, --कं, क्रीडनीयं, --यकं A
play-thing, toy; Ś. 7.

क्रीडनकः, --कं, क्रीडनीयं, --यकं A
play-thing, toy; Ś. 7.

क्रीडनकः, --कं, क्रीडनीयं, --यकं A
play-thing, toy; Ś. 7.

क्रीडनकः, --कं, क्रीडनीयं, --यकं A
play-thing, toy; Ś. 7.

क्रीडि a. Ved. Playing, sporting,
(epithet of the wind.)

क्रीडु a. Ved. Playing, moving up
[]
(as the Soma).
